meaning: The metropolitan market assigned to the campaign record; currently New York City.
The identifier that groups recipients, postcards, website visits, leads, and results into one campaign.
The unique campaign-level recipient identifier; copied from the source mailing_id for New York City.
The recipient's LLC-count segment: 2-3 LLCs, 4-6 LLCs, 7-10 LLCs, or 11+ LLCs.
The recipient's property-count segment: 2-3 properties, 4-9 properties, 10-24 properties, or 25+ properties.
Describes whether the mapped properties are concentrated in one borough, distributed across multiple boroughs, or could not be mapped.
The approved location label used in personalized messaging, such as Queens, Brooklyn, or New York City.
The New York City borough containing the largest number of mapped properties for the recipient.
The number of mapped properties located in the dominant holdings borough.
The number of properties whose ZIP codes were successfully mapped to a New York City borough.
The percentage of mapped properties located in the dominant borough.
The strength of the borough concentration: STRONG, MODERATE, DISTRIBUTED, or UNMAPPED.
An audit summary showing mapped property counts by borough, for example Queens: 7 | Brooklyn: 2.
The messaging category selected from portfolio size: GROWING_PORTFOLIO, ESTABLISHED_PORTFOLIO, PORTFOLIO_SCALE, or COMPLEX_PORTFOLIO.
The proposed recipient-specific sentence for the printed postcard.
The proposed personalized headline displayed after the recipient scans the QR code.
The proposed explanatory copy displayed on the personalized landing page.
The call-to-action text shown on the personalized landing page.
The future random, non-guessable value that will connect one postcard to one privacy-minimized website record; currently blank.
The future public landing-page URL containing the recipient's tracking token; currently blank.
The future URL value that the postcard vendor will encode into the recipient's QR code; currently blank.
The production status of the recipient's QR code; currently waiting for the public website.
The mailing release control; currently on hold until postal validation and final campaign suppression are complete.
Indicates whether the proposed personalized messaging is ready for human review.
